segments.en: It is day 4. Alex is new on the team. Alex is new, so the team uses short sentences. In the morning, Alex practises "variable" and "value" while looking at the computer. Maria starts a short conversation. She says "How much is this?" and "That's too expensive.". Alex listens and replies. After lunch, Alex works with the team on GitHub. The team talks about "branch" and "main branch". Alex repeats the new words twice and feels ready for the next small step.
